question: In which year did India make its One-Day International (ODI) debut?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1974.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India made its **One-Day International (ODI) debut** in the year **1974.**
 
• India's first ODI match was against** England** in 1974.
 
• Their **first T20I match** was against **South Africa** in** 2006.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The men's national cricket team of India took on England in their **first-ever international match** on** June 25, 1932**, during the Lord's Test, making them the sixth team to be awarded Test cricket status.
 
• India's first Test victory did not come until **1952, **a span of nearly twenty years. 
 
• A** One Day International **(ODI) is a type of limited-overs cricket match that takes place between** two international teams.**
 
• The match lasts up to **seven hours** and features a set number of overs—**currently 50**—for each team.
 
• This format is used for the Cricket World Cup, which is usually contested** every four years.**
 
• **Limited Overs Internationals **(LOI) is another name for One Day International matches.
